mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates compress equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as long as rates remain near zero.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% signals weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.5%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) indicate severe economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE>8.5% AND INDPRO<95.0) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, with Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 0.25%) increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) signal expanding consumer demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 550.0 indicate a contracting housing market that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 550.0) combined with high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.25%) signal a housing market collapse under monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST<550.0 AND FEDFUNDS>0.25%) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, with Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Supply contraction regimes (INDPRO < 95.0) indicate declining industrial output that reduces corporate profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0.
